note: Pilot of the no_catalog method: 11 rows with no per-site RIDB data, worked from the facility description, the agency page and dated reviews instead. 3 added, 8 excluded. Hotelling is filed OR but is in California (Klamath NF). The facility description alone settled 3 exclusions (tent-only, walk-in); agency or review length statements settled the rest.

added.name: Mecca Flat Campground (Deschutes River)
added.caveat: no agency length; dated reviews put a 34-ft Class A and 26-30 ft trailers in; narrow single-lane access road

added.name: Duncan Reservoir Campground (Silver Lake)
added.caveat: no published length; pull-through sites on open ground

added.name: Big Spring Campground (Ochoco NF)
added.caveat: no published length; FS calls it the easiest trailer access on the forest but says trailer sites are limited in size and number

excluded.name: River Bench Campground (Illinois River)
excluded.why: '8 walk in campsites'; parking above, hike down to the sites

excluded.name: Saddle Creek Campground (Hells Canyon)
excluded.why: '7 walk-in tent-only sites' on the Hat Point Road

excluded.name: Wahtum Lake Campground (Mt. Hood NF)
excluded.why: park in a lot and walk to 5 primitive sites

excluded.name: Alder Springs Campground (McKenzie Pass)
excluded.why: 20-ft maximum trailer length; tent and small RVs only

excluded.name: Hotelling Campground (Klamath NF, CA)
excluded.why: room to back in a 20-ft trailer or smaller; 4 sites for single vehicles

excluded.name: North Fork Siuslaw Campground
excluded.why: dispersed, 7 sites; the largest fit vans, the rest barely a tent

excluded.name: Shady Campground (Lostine River)
excluded.why: 7 tent/trailer sites but no length from any source and no reviewer rig; the road roughens up the canyon. Revisit if the FS publishes lengths

method_notes: Per row: RIDB facility description first (it decided 3 of 11), then the agency page, then dated review rigs (Campendium rig lengths were the only size evidence at Mecca Flat). Satellite at the facility pin, zoomed to z19 where the pads are legible; OSM campsite nodes confirm the pin where the canopy hides the campground (Big Spring).
About 10-15 minutes a row, and 3 of 11 added: the no_catalog rows are mostly small primitive camps that fail the size gate, so the yield is far lower than the likely_rv list's.
